name: Switchblade (Combat)
body:
Your deft hands and dancing feet make you a blur on the battlefield.

Prerequisite(s): Swap Places, Weapon Finesse, positioning attack rogue talent.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can make a single melee attack with a light weapon as a melee touch attack. Your attack deals half damage, and after resolving your attack you can take a 5-foot step into the space of a willing ally. That ally can take a 5-foot step as an immediate action to move into the space you have just left. Your ally need not have the Swap Places feat to make this movement.
